title: Lizper Spitter
html:
A level 42 Lizper that attacks with stab (ranged).

Fighting it

Weak freezestab   Resists corrodecrush

⭐ Seen as an elite 2 times (2.0% of sightings). Elites have 3× HP, hit 1.4× harder, give 3× XP and 2.5× loot.

Reagent: Goblin Haft Binding (rerolls quality). A small chance on any kill, far better from elites. Reforging
